arxiv-2011-07195.title: Counterfactual universal quantum computation
arxiv-2011-07195.creator: Zhu Cao
arxiv-2011-07195.description: Abstract Universal quantum computation is usually associated with interaction among two-level quantum subsystems, as this interaction is commonly viewed as a necessity to achieve universal quantum computation. In this work, we show that, contrary to this intuition, universal quantum computation can be achieved without interaction among initially independent two-level quantum subsystems. We call it counterfactual universal quantum computation.

arxiv-2202-08835.title: General Cyclical Training of Neural Networks
arxiv-2202-08835.creator: Leslie N. Smith
arxiv-2202-08835.description: Abstract This paper describes the principle of “General Cyclical Training” in machine learning, where training starts and ends with “easy training” and the “hard training” happens during the middle epochs. We propose several manifestations for training neural networks, including algorithmic examples (via hyper-parameters and loss functions), data-based examples, and model-based examples.

arxiv-2301-02956.title: Vibronic excitations in resonant inelastic x-ray scattering spectra of K 2 RuCl 6
arxiv-2301-02956.creator: Naoya Iwahara, Shouta Shikano
arxiv-2301-02956.description: Abstract We present the fingerprints of dynamic Jahn-Teller effect in resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) spectra of K 2 RuCl 6 . We determined the dynamic Jahn-Teller model Hamiltonian of an embedded Ru 4+ ion using post Hartree-Fock methods, and derived the vibronic states by numerically diagonalizing the Hamiltonian. With the obtained vibronic states, we reproduced the RIXS spectra.

arxiv-2309-12575.title: Nonparametric Estimation of the Underlying Distribution of Binned Continuous Data
arxiv-2309-12575.creator: Ejike R. Ugba & Jan Gertheiss †
arxiv-2309-12575.description: Abstract Abstract Estimating cumulative distribution functions (CDF) and probability density functions (PDF) is a fundamental practice in applied statistics. However, challenges often arise when dealing with data arranged in grouped intervals. This paper discusses a suitable and highly flexible non-parametric density estimation approach for binned distributions, based on cubic monotonicity-preserving splines—known as cubic spline interpolation.

arxiv-2410-16668.title: Satori: Towards Proactive AR Assistant with Belief-Desire-Intention User Modeling
arxiv-2410-16668.creator: Chenyi Li, Guande Wu, Gromit Yeuk-Yin Chan, Dishita G Turakhia, Sonia Castelo, Dong Li, Leslie Welch, Cláudio T. Silva, Jing Qian
arxiv-2410-16668.description: Abstract . Augmented Reality (AR) assistance is increasingly used for supporting users with physical tasks like assembly and cooking. However, most systems rely on reactive responses triggered by user input, overlooking rich contextual and user-specific information. To address this, we present Satori, a novel AR system that proactively guides users by modeling both – their mental states and environmental contexts.

arxiv-2503-11776.title: Radio study of the colliding wind binary HD 93129A near periastron and its surroundings

HD 93129A is an O+O stellar system whose colliding-wind region (CWR) has been mapped by high angular resolution observations at cm wavelengths. The synchrotron nature of the radio emission confirms its particle accelerator status. According to the analysis of astrometric measurements since 1996, the system has an orbital period of ∼ \sim 120 yr and recently went through its periastron passage.
